83 Jews among 220 taxpayers (37.7%); taxpayer count not total population
587 Jews in Lesko town; 1656 in the whole kahal (regional figure not used)
Jewish population 2400 (c. 63% of total) per Encyclopaedia Judaica
2338 Jews (61.4% of 3806 residents); another source gives 3870 total (60.3%)
Approximately 2500 Jews on the eve of WWII (Year of Data approximated as 1939)

German occupation June 1941; Jewish community (about 60% of town) later murdered; Encyclopaedia Judaica says the entire Jewish population was deported to Zaslaw on 14 Aug 1941 (date differs from other sources)
June 1942 ghetto for Jews of town and vicinity; liquidated August 1942; about 100 shot at the cemetery; rest sent to Zaslaw labour camp then Belzec. Ghetto count not given. 10-20 survived hidden
Postwar: no Jewish community left in Lesko (synagogue fell into ruin); Year of Data approximate
